description: On The Haus is hosted by Sam Hauser, Joey Hauser, and their dad Dave. Each week, they break down what’s happening in the NBA, college basketball, and the world of sports, share their favorite movies and shows, and answer fan questions along the way.
title: On The Haus Podcast

C1LsOTHiuQ4.desc: On this episode of On The Haus, Sam and Joey sit down with Steven Izzo, son of Michigan State head coach Tom Izzo. Steven talks about growing up in the heart of college basketball, his time as a walk-on at Michigan State, and his close friendship with Joey. Steven talks about life on and off the court, insights into what makes Michigan State basketball special, and their time as teammates at MSU.
C1LsOTHiuQ4.title: Ep. 5 | With Special Guest Steven Izzo
